zh.meta_line: 生成于 {stamp}。{level}{desc} 按住拖动画布，触控板两指滑动也能移，捏合或按住 ⌘ 滚轮缩放；点节点展开或收起，右栏看说明、写反馈。
zh.search_hint_default: 搜索节点标题、说明、来源
zh.fb_placeholder: 想说什么直接写，不引用也行。要针对某一条：点节点右上角橙色的 💬，或在详情、大纲里选中一段字点「引用」。
zh.fb_hint: ⌘ + 回车 交；草稿自动存着
zh.btn_copy_title: 把还没复制过的反馈整理成一段字放进剪贴板，到会话里粘贴发出
zh.cp_text: 请按 ⌘C 复制下面这段（已经选中了），到会话里粘贴发出。
zh.legend_suffix: ⓘ 表示有详细说明，点节点在右栏看；「+N」是收起的下级数量；橙色「💬N」是你在这一条上写过几条反馈。
zh.node_fb_title: 你在这一条上交过的反馈
zh.children_head: 下一级（{n} 项，点一下跳过去）
zh.hits_found: 找到 {n} 处，回车跳下一处
zh.hits_at: 第 {i} / {n} 处，回车跳下一处
zh.chip_revising: 正在改之前交出去的 {id}，交了会注明是改写
zh.toast_not_found: 图里找不到这一条了，可能改过名
zh.item_ctx: 没引用；交的时候选中的是「{x}」
zh.item_orphan: 这条不是在这个浏览器里写的，下面是我收到的原话和回复
zh.item_sent: 已复制给 AI（{when}）。我回复后刷新这页，回复会显示在这里
zh.item_unsent: 还没复制给 AI，只存在这个浏览器里
zh.empty_p1: 想针对某一条，就把鼠标移到图上那个节点，点右上角橙色的 💬；或者点开节点，在上面的详情里点「引用这一条去反馈」。
zh.empty_p2: 只想引其中一句：在详情或大纲视图里选中那段字，点弹出来的「引用这段」。可以引好几处，也可以一处都不引，直接写。
zh.empty_p3: 疑问、看不懂的、要改的、你的决定，都可以写。写完一批点下面「复制给 AI」，到会话里粘贴发出；回复后刷新这页，回复会显示在对应那条下面。
zh.conn_bad: 这个窗口存不住，关掉就没了；请用浏览器打开这个文件，或写完马上复制给 AI
zh.toast_need_text_quoted: 引用好了，再写一句你想说的
zh.confirm_delete_sent: 这条已经复制给 AI 了，只是从这个浏览器里删掉，确定吗？
zh.confirm_submit_first: 输入框里还有没交的话，先把它交了再复制吗？
zh.toast_all_copied: 都复制过了；要再发一遍点「全部再复制一次」
zh.toast_copied: 已复制 {n} 条，到会话里粘贴发出就行

en.meta_line: Generated {stamp}. {level}{desc} Drag to pan; pinch, or hold Ctrl/⌘ and scroll, to zoom. Click a node to select and expand it, and click it again to collapse it. Notes and feedback are in the right panel.
en.fb_placeholder: Write whatever you like; quoting is optional. To point at a node, hover over it and click the orange 💬 at its corner, or select some text in the details or outline and click “Quote this”.
en.btn_copy_title: Put the feedback you haven't copied yet on the clipboard as one block of text, then paste it into your chat
en.cp_text: The text below is already selected. Press ⌘C (Ctrl+C) to copy it, then paste it into your chat.
en.legend_suffix: ⓘ = has notes or sources (click the node to read them); “+N” = collapsed nodes below; orange “💬N” = feedback you wrote on this node.
en.node_quote_title: Quote this node in your feedback
en.node_fb_title: Feedback you have written on this node

children_head.one: Next level (1 item, click to jump)
children_head.other: Next level ({n} items, click to jump)

en.quote_goto_title: Click to find it in the map
en.chip_revising: Revising {id}, which you already copied for AI; it will be marked as a revision.
en.toast_not_found: That node is no longer in the map; it may have been renamed.
en.item_ctx: No quote. The node selected when you wrote this: “{x}”
en.item_orphan: Not saved in this browser: written elsewhere, or deleted here. Showing your original words and the reply.
en.item_sent: Copied for AI ({when}). After the AI replies, refresh this page and the reply will show up here.
en.item_unsent: Not copied for AI yet; saved only in this browser.
en.act_edit_title: Move it back to the input box to edit
en.empty_p1: To point at one node, hover over it on the map and click the orange 💬 at its top-right corner, or click the node and press “Quote this node” in the details above.
en.empty_p2: To quote a single sentence, select it in the details or the outline view and click the “Quote this” button that pops up. You can quote several places, or none and just write.
en.empty_p3: Questions, confusing parts, corrections and your decisions are all welcome. When you have a batch, click “Copy for AI” below and paste it into your chat. After the AI replies, refresh this page and the reply appears under the matching item.
en.conn_bad: Can't save in this window; open the file in a regular browser
en.toast_need_text_quoted: Quote added. Now write what you want to say.
en.confirm_delete_sent: This one was already copied for the AI. It will only be deleted from this browser. Continue?
en.confirm_submit_first: The input box has text that isn't added yet. OK adds it and copies it too; Cancel copies without it.
en.toast_all_copied: Everything has been copied already. To copy it all again, click “Copy everything again”.

toast_copied.one: Copied 1 item. Paste it into your chat.
toast_copied.other: Copied {n} items. Paste them into your chat.

en.export_reply: Write replies back to the page: {cmd}
en.export_noquote: (no quote; the node selected when written: {path})
